question: Does decision-aligned end-to-end fine-tuning change the K35 versus K65 conclusion under all-evidence target evaluation?

training.trial_objective: class-weighted binary cross entropy divided by log(2)
training.decision_objective: nine-candidate listwise cross entropy divided by log(9) on source groups retaining at least one post-QC trial for every candidate
training.candidate_score: gain * weighted_mean(centered trial evidence) * effective_count ** count_power
training.incomplete_source_group_policy: retain every remaining EEG row in trial CE and give only that incomplete group zero weight in the listwise term
training.validation_selection: none; fixed budget because the initialization already saw every legal source subject

endpoints.primary: requested-cohort operational hit@all using learned tempered evidence
endpoints.matched_control: requested-cohort operational hit@all using fixed candidate mean after the same end-to-end fine-tune

comparison_unit: subject after averaging three seed correctness indicators
inference_scope: GTN development cohort only; kernel choice remains provisional until independent confirmation
